description: Run build and test before AI review in the check stage, failing fast before review artifacts or approval when mechanical verification fails.

tasks.title: Gate check-stage review behind build/test
tasks.description: Refactor check-stage orchestration so `BuildTestCheck` runs before `CheckStageRunner.executeTasks()` generates or reuses `review.md` and `review-self-check.md`. Preserve existing autofix behavior for build/test, then continue to review artifact generation, `AiReviewCheck`, and `UserApprovalCheck` only after build/test passes.
acceptanceCriteria: Check stage runs BuildTestCheck before any review artifact generation logic is executed
Build/test pass on the first attempt continues to review artifact generation and existing AI review behavior
Build/test fail followed by successful autofix reruns the same configured command and then continues to AI review
Build/test fail after max autofix attempts returns a failed check-stage result before review.md or review-self-check.md is generated
User approval is not requested when build/test fails before AI review
Existing checks.buildTest command and timeout configuration remain supported
tasks.notes: Implement the design's pre-task check phase or an equivalent minimal orchestration that avoids duplicating BaseStageRunner status, persistence, reaction, and approval handling. Autofix continuation must stay scoped to the active phase so AiReviewCheck is not run before review.md exists.

tasks.title: Add check-stage ordering regression tests
tasks.description: Add automated regression coverage proving the new check-stage order and failure behavior. Tests should exercise success, build/test autofix success, build/test autofix exhaustion, skipped review artifact generation on mechanical failure, and approval request gating.
acceptanceCriteria: A test proves BuildTestCheck runs before review.md or review-self-check.md generation
A test proves build/test failure after max autofix attempts stops the check stage with a clear failure result
A test proves review.md and review-self-check.md are not generated when build/test fails
A test proves approval_requested is not emitted unless build/test and AI review have passed
A test proves build/test failure output includes a concise message and a useful truncated buildLog excerpt
tasks.notes: Prefer focused unit or integration tests around CheckStageRunner/BaseStageRunner rather than broad end-to-end tests. Mock checks and artifact generation where possible to make ordering assertions deterministic.
